meta title "code-bash.sh"
section* 0
  text "code-bash.sh"
para
  text "Rinse the cache"
para
  text "An invented script for the code-file reader’s golden fixture. Its leading comment block reads as prose above the code."
verbatim language bash
  "#!/usr/bin/env bash"
  "set -eu"
  ""
  "cache=\"${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rinse\"  # a trailing comment stays in the code"
  "mkdir -p \"$cache\""
  "echo \"rinsed $cache\""
-- diagnostics
(none)
